temporal_validity_audit.continuous_segment_definition: maximal within-sequence selected-frame runs with every source-frame gap equal to 1 and at least 2 frames
temporal_validity_audit.interpretation_boundary: Frozen E4 output was not regenerated. Sparse selected frames can carry prior E4 state across unobserved source-frame intervals; this audit is post-hoc and cannot establish continuous-video or TrackTrack performance.

final_system_evidence.evidence: D1 R2 Macro F1=0.664318; D1-LL R2 Macro F1=0.617484.
final_system_evidence.decision: Keep D1 as the default detector.
final_system_evidence.claim_boundary: D1-LL remains a frozen negative low-light fine-tuning experiment.

final_system_evidence.decision: Use B1 + F2 in the default occupancy path.
final_system_evidence.claim_boundary: Post-hoc attribution on frozen Stage Q-v2 outputs.

final_system_evidence.evidence: D1 F2-to-E4 occupied-recall change=+0.075188; Macro-F1 change=-0.042363.
final_system_evidence.decision: Make E4 conditional on genuinely continuous video.

final_system_evidence.evidence: 9 selected-frame boundaries have source-frame gap > 1; maximum gap=136 frames.
final_system_evidence.decision: Do not use Stage Q-v2 as continuous-video proof.
final_system_evidence.claim_boundary: No timestamps/FPS or seconds-level latency claimed.

final_system_evidence.evidence: Stage Q-v2 tracker backend is none; TrackTrack was not run.
final_system_evidence.decision: Retain TrackTrack as an independent optional MOT module.
final_system_evidence.claim_boundary: No claim that TrackTrack improves slot-level occupancy.

conclusion.conditional_module: F2 -> E4 only for genuinely continuous video after calibration
conclusion.independent_experimental_module: TrackTrack after detection for MOT research; not default occupancy
